comment: The Layers docker at the default layout holds fourteen rows with no scroll bar. The window is 1920 by 1080 and the default layout is loaded, so the Colour Picker is 310 by 396 at (1600, 78) and Layers 310 by 581 at (1600, 484), ending at y 1065 with the Reference. Twelve layers are added over Layer 1 and the Background, fourteen in all, each filled a colour of its own so its thumbnail tells it apart. The blend dropdown and the opacity slider share one row under the list, the dropdown on the left. The state dump's layers_docker rows give every row's rect, 302 wide because no scroll bar takes a share of the row. The pointer then rests on the slider, and the tooltip's report carries the word Opacity, which left the slider's face for the room the dropdown's name needs.
